instructions.meaning: Intentへ追加した能力確認後の限定的AI判断委譲方針を、初期Human mode、能力評価、段階導入、権限制御、停止・取消し、Provenanceを含む統合計画へ反映する

session_evidence.retained_evidence: decision-scoped Human instruction, prior conditional-delegation Intent record and updated artifact digests
session_evidence.retention_limitation: 会話全体の永続参照identityは取得できないため、計画書への反映指示、初期範囲、段階導入、権限境界、成果物Digestを本recordへ保持する

plan_change_summary.initial_mode: All acceptance, completion, stage and release decisions remain Human decisions through the initial release; no Delegation Authorization is issued.
authorization_design: Human-issued, versioned and time-bounded Delegation Authorization
decision-class, requirement, contract, risk, model, capability, tool, permission and side-effect scope
capability evidence, thresholds, known limitations and stop conditions
fail-closed scope and validity checks before a delegated decision can change workflow state
Human-only creation, expansion, renewal and reactivation of delegation
revocation and capability-degradation impact closure with stale downstream decisions
provenance_and_evaluation: Decision Record separates decision content from authority
delegated decisions bind actor, authorization digest, capability evidence, scope check and outcome
initial Human decisions and downstream outcomes supply later capability evidence
metrics include override, escalation, scope violation, false acceptance, false completion and degradation

scope_boundary.included_now: Plan policy, authority model, initial provenance readiness, negative paths and deferred rollout gates
scope_boundary.excluded_from_initial_release: active AI decision delegation and Delegation Authorization issuance
scope_boundary.required_before_implementation: separate Requirements delta, threat model, acceptance tests, rollback and Human approval

verification.intent_reference_check: passed: consolidated Plan references the current conditional-delegation Intent digest
verification.plan_consistency_self_check: passed: initial Human gates remain authoritative, delegation is deferred, evidence-based, bounded, revocable and fail-closed
